During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Codex" /> a twenty-eight-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] conflict spanning from [[3681 BBY]] to [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> a '''battle''' occurred on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Warren Sedoru]] was among the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Republic forces who fought in the battle, though he was critically injured during the fighting.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle at Yavin 4 was first mentioned in the in-game Codex entry for Warren Sedoru in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" /> The entries wording, "[...]in battles from Alderaan to Yavin Four," suggests the Battle of Yavin 4 might have taken place after the [[Battle of Alderaan]], which would place it between [[3667 BBY|3667]] and 3653 BBY.<ref name="Codex" />
